idea: Head count: the four numbers in the most policies' top 6, one vote per policy
why: The ledger keeps showing winners that share my two most-backed numbers while my fourth pick lets me down. So this time no story, just a straight head count of the 13 policies' top 6s. 24 and 26 are in seven each, 75 in five and 2 in four. 24 is on a tear: drawn in 9 of the last 10 games. 26 has 9 in the last 20, 75 is joint most drawn over 100, and 2 has 5 in the last 10.
